name: aginera-for-manufacturing
description: Construction-drawing and CAD intelligence for manufacturers. Takeoffs from customer bid sets with every quantity cited to its sheet, PDF drawings converted to DXF/DWG for Fusion, 3D part models from a description or a PDF drawing (text to CAD) with STL/STEP files, plant floor plans turned into clean CAD and 3D images or walkthrough films, and quantities for plant expansions. Hands off to Claude for Manufacturing's RFQ intake, quote-build, supplier RFQ, design and production-report skills.
